name: qradar
label: IBM QRadar
description: IBM QRadar is an enterprise security information and event management (SIEM) product. Fortinet FortiSOAR connector for IBM QRadar allows users to invoke QRadar API, perform Ariel Queries and operations like Get Offense,related events,update and close offenses.

fields.title: Address
fields.name: address
fields.description: Specify the IP address of the IBM QRadar server to which you connect and perform automated operations.
fields.tooltip: Specify the IP address of the IBM QRadar server to which you connect and perform automated operations.

fields.title: API Token
fields.name: token
fields.description: Specify the API token to access the IBM QRadar server to which you connect and perform automated operations. In MSSP environments, the token must have full administrative permissions across all domains.
fields.tooltip: Specify the API token to access the IBM QRadar server to which you connect and perform automated operations. In MSSP environments, the token must have full administrative permissions across all domains.

fields.title: API Version
fields.name: api_version
fields.description: Specify the version of the IBM QRadar API to use for automated operations. By default, this is set to 14.0.
fields.tooltip: Specify the version of the IBM QRadar API to use for automated operations. By default, this is set to 14.0.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description: Select this option to verify the SSL certificate of the server. By default, this is set to true.
fields.tooltip: Select this option to verify the SSL certificate of the server. By default, this is set to true.

operations.title: Get Offenses from QRadar
operations.description: Retrieves a list of offenses from the QRadar server based on the filter string that you have specified.

parameters.title: Filter String
parameters.description: Specify the filter string based on which you want to retrieve offenses from QRadar. For example, assigned_to="admin". By default, this is set to status="OPEN".
parameters.name: filter_string
parameters.tooltip: Specify the filter string based on which you want to retrieve offenses from QRadar. For example, assigned_to="admin". By default, this is set to status="OPEN".

operations.title: Make an Ariel Query to QRadar
operations.description: Runs an Ariel query on the QRadar server based on the Ariel search string that you have specified. QRadar uses the Ariel Query Language (AQL) to search for offenses or events.

parameters.title: Ariel Search String
parameters.description: Specify the Ariel query that you want to run on the QRadar server.
parameters.name: search_string
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Ariel query that you want to run on the QRadar server.
parameters.placeholder: For e.g. SELECT sourceip, starttime, qid, sourceport  from events

operations.title: Get Offense Closing Reasons
operations.description: Retrieves the list of offense closing reasons from the QRadar server.

operations.title: Get Offense Types
operations.description: Retrieves the list of all offense types, with their IDs, from the QRadar server.

operations.title: Get Offense Notes
operations.description: Retrieves the notes associated with an offense from the QRadar server based on the offense ID that you have specified.

parameters.title: Offense ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the offense whose notes you want to retrieve from the QRadar server.
parameters.name: offense_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the offense whose notes you want to retrieve from the QRadar server.

operations.title: Close Offense
operations.description: Closes an offense on the QRadar server based on the offense ID and closing reason ID that you have specified.

parameters.title: Offense ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the offense that you want to close on the QRadar server.
parameters.name: offense_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the offense that you want to close on the QRadar server.

parameters.title: Closing Reason ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the closing reason with which you want to close the offense. To retrieve closing reason IDs, use the Get Offense Closing Reasons action.
parameters.name: offense_close_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the closing reason with which you want to close the offense. To retrieve closing reason IDs, use the Get Offense Closing Reasons action.

parameters.title: Closure Note
parameters.name: closure_note
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the note that you want to add to the offense when you close it.
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the note that you want to add to the offense when you close it.

operations.title: Create Note
operations.description: Creates a note for an offense on the QRadar server based on the offense ID and note text that you have specified.

parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the offense for which you want to create a note on the QRadar server.

parameters.description: Specify the text of the note that you want to create for the offense.

parameters.tooltip: Specify the text of the note that you want to create for the offense.

operations.title: Delete or Purge Reference Table
operations.description: Deletes a reference table from QRadar, or purges only its content, based on the reference table name and other input parameters that you have specified. To retrieve the names and details of reference tables, use the Get Reference Tables action.

parameters.title: Reference Table Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the reference table that you want to delete or purge on QRadar.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the reference table that you want to delete or purge on QRadar.
parameters.name: path.name

parameters.title: Purge Table
parameters.description: Select the 'true' option from the Purge Table drop-down list if you want to have the contents of the specified reference table to be purged from QRadar, i.e., in this case, the structure of the specified reference table is retained. Select the 'false' (default) option from the Purge Table drop-down list to purge the contents of the specified reference table, i.e., in this case, the specified reference table is completely removed.
parameters.tooltip: This indicates if the reference table should have its contents purged (if the value is true), keeping the reference table structure. If the value is false, or not specified the reference table is removed completely.
parameters.name: query.purge_only

parameters.title: Fields
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the fields to include in the response. Fields that you do not specify are excluded. Specify subfields in brackets, and separate multiple fields in the same object with commas.
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the fields to include in the response. Fields that you do not specify are excluded. Specify subfields in brackets, and separate multiple fields in the same object with commas.
parameters.name: query.fields

parameters.title: Namespace
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the namespace of the reference table that you want to delete or purge. By default, this is SHARED for admin users and TENANT for tenant users. If you set Purge Table to true, the default is SHARED for all users.
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the namespace of the reference table that you want to delete or purge. By default, this is SHARED for admin users and TENANT for tenant users. If you set Purge Table to true, the default is SHARED for all users.
parameters.name: query.namespace
